facts.summary: FDA demands ~700-patient non-inferiority mortality trial for first-line use · Phase 3 planning · MAT2203 in invasive aspergillosis · not yet approved

evidence.summary: FDA indicated that approval of MAT2203 as a first-line treatment for invasive aspergillosis will require an adequately powered study with an active control group and an all-cause mortality non-inferiority margin of 10%
evidence.safety: Throughout this period, the patient displayed excellent tolerance to MAT2203, and subsequent imaging revealed radiologic improvement in the invasive fungal infections.
